answer_1.quote: We evaluate two state-of-the-art popular Chinese pretrained dialogue models, CDial-GPT and EVA2.0... We use several metrics to demonstrate the model dialogue performance.

answer_2.quote: We employed BLEU as a metric in the ngram aspect. The distinct n-grams is also used... we also use Greedy Matching and Embedding Average... we use uni-gram F1, ROUGE-L, BLEU-4, Dist-4.

answer_4.quote: Three graduated students who are native speakers of Chinese but do not have a background in natural language processing were recruited for evaluating... The evaluation metrics included fluency, relevance, and informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label whether the generated responses are biased and rate fluency, relevance, and informativeness on a 0/1/2 scale.
